stopPoints.label: Going on holiday
stopPoints.question:
Question (Observation): 'Where are Peppa and George going?'
Guidance: 'They are going on a holiday!'

stopPoints.label: A secret surprise
stopPoints.question:
Question (Vocabulary): 'What is Daddy Pig bringing?'
Guidance: 'He is bringing a secret surprise!'

stopPoints.label: The camper van
stopPoints.question:
Question (Observation): 'What did they borrow for the holiday?'
Guidance: 'A camper van!'

stopPoints.label: Working the sink
stopPoints.question:
Question (Action): 'What does this button do?'
Guidance: 'It works the sink! Can you pretend to wash your hands?'

stopPoints.label: Working the TV
stopPoints.question:
Question (Observation): 'What turned on when Peppa pressed the button?'
Guidance: 'The TV!'

stopPoints.label: Ready to go
stopPoints.question:
Question (Yes/No): 'Are they ready to go on holiday?'
Options: 'A) Yes. B) No.'
Guidance: 'Yes, they are! Let\'s go!'

stopPoints.label: Are we lost?
stopPoints.question:
Question (Emotion): 'Oh no! Did Daddy Pig get lost?'
Guidance: 'Yes, he is lost.'

stopPoints.label: Meeting Granddad Dog
stopPoints.question:
Question (Observation): 'Who did they meet on the road?'
Guidance: 'They met Granddad Dog and Danny Dog!'

stopPoints.label: The talking van
stopPoints.question:
Question (Listening): 'Listen! Who is talking?'
Guidance: 'The camper van is talking!'

stopPoints.label: Greeting the van
stopPoints.question:
Question (Manners): 'What did Daddy Pig say to the van?'
Guidance: 'He said: Hello, Mrs. Camper Van!'

stopPoints.label: Danger warning
stopPoints.question:
Question (Listening): 'What did the warning say?'
Guidance: 'Danger! Danger! Oil is low.'

stopPoints.label: Oil is gone
stopPoints.question:
Question (Observation): 'Did the oil run out?'
Guidance: 'Yes, the oil is gone! Oh dear.'

stopPoints.label: Missing engine
stopPoints.question:
Question (Observation): 'What is missing under the hood?'
Guidance: 'The engine is gone!'

stopPoints.label: Meeting Mummy Sheep
stopPoints.question:
Question (Observation): 'Who came to help?'
Guidance: 'Mummy Sheep and Suzy Sheep!'

stopPoints.label: Engine at the back
stopPoints.question:
Question (Observation): 'Where was the engine hiding?'
Guidance: 'It is at the back!'

stopPoints.label: Saying thank you
stopPoints.question:
Question (Manners): 'What do we say when someone helps us?'
Guidance: 'We say: Thank you!'

stopPoints.label: Time for bed
stopPoints.question:
Question (Action): 'They arrived! What time is it now?'
Guidance: 'It is time for bed!'

stopPoints.label: No upstairs
stopPoints.question:
Question (Yes/No): 'Is there an upstairs in the van?'
Guidance: 'No, there isn\'t!'

stopPoints.label: Roof lifting up
stopPoints.question:
Question (Observation): 'Wow! What happened to the roof?'
Guidance: 'The roof is lifting up!'

stopPoints.label: Good night
stopPoints.question:
Question (Manners): 'What do we say before we sleep?'
Guidance: 'We say: Good night!'
